title: Workspace layout
description: Page type “workspace” (L12): a control panel on the left (segmented tabs, back + tool name, sections with a text-overline label and a counter like “3/8”, drop zones, steppers, a message box) with the main action pinned at its bottom, and the result on the right. Phones stack the panel above the result with the action at the bottom of the screen.
when: A tool where the user sets inputs and sees what they produce: a quote request and its comparison, a generator, an import with a preview, a print job.
A record being composed step by step, with one main action at the end (Gửi hỏi giá, Tạo, In).

instead.need: A list of records with search and filters
A form that saves fields of one record
Settings that apply to a stand-alone tool app's canvas

a11y: Two named regions (panel and result: “Bảng điều khiển”, “Kết quả”, override with panelLabel / resultLabel); each WorkspaceSection is a group named by its label.
WorkspaceHeader's title is the page h1 by default; headings in the result start at h2. The back button is a link named by backLabel (where it goes).

examples.title: Quote request
examples.description: Tabs, back + name, sections with counters, steppers, a drop zone, a message with @ and / hints; the comparison on the right. Below lg the panel stacks on top and its action stays at the bottom of the screen (not inside this docs frame, which scrolls sideways: sticky needs a page that scrolls vertically).

examples.title: In the app shell
examples.description: AppShell with the phone tab bar (mobileNav="tabs"): the main action stays above the tab bar. Full screen at /demo/workspace/.

examples.title: Minimal
examples.description: No header: just sections, the action and the result.

examples.title: Read-only viewer
examples.description: Omit `action` when the viewer cannot commit: no pinned bottom bar is rendered.

notes: The panel is 380px wide on lg+, sticky under the top of the scrolling area, and scrolls inside; the result scrolls with the page. On phones the action sticks at `bottom: var(--semi-bottom-bar, 0px)`: AppShell sets it to the tab bar's height in tabs mode, so the action sits above MobileTabBar.

One primary in the action bar (`fullWidth` on `Button` or `SplitButton`), a secondary beside it at most (Lưu nháp). Omit `action` for a read-only viewer. Section labels are the only uppercase text (text-overline, written in sentence case in code).

Record as WorkspaceLayout vs DetailOverlay: use WorkspaceLayout when a stored record has its own route and a large live result (e.g. a quote comparison matrix); use DetailOverlay for a quick look from a list. Keep inputs and context in the panel and move history/activity below the main result so phone panels stay short.
Do not put WorkspaceLayout inside an overflow-x-auto / overflow-hidden box: that box becomes the sticky container and the phone action no longer stays on screen.
